title: Unsupervised Image Decomposition with Phase-Correlation Networks
venueFull: International Conference on Computer Vision Theory and Applications (VISAPP)
summary: Introduces PCDNet, which decomposes a scene into transformed versions of learned object prototypes. Its core is a frequency-domain Phase-Correlation Cell. PCDNet beats prior methods on unsupervised object discovery and segmentation benchmarks while using few parameters and staying fully interpretable.
